card.fact_statement: Cambodia's Ministry of Culture and Fine Arts condemned Thai military attacks on Prasat Ta Khwai.
card.source_span: Cambodia's Ministry of Culture and Fine Arts condemned Thai military attacks on Prasat Ta Khwai, describing them as "profoundly immoral" and a violation of cultural heritage.

target_qa_variants.question: Wizara ya Utamaduni na Sanaa ya Kambodia ililaani mashambulizi ya kijeshi ya Thailand kwenye eneo gani la urithi wa kitamaduni wakati wa mgogoro wa mpaka kati ya Kambodia na Thailand wa mwaka 2025?
target_qa_variants.source_span: Cambodia's Ministry of Culture and Fine Arts condemned Thai military attacks on Prasat Ta Khwai, describing them as "profoundly immoral" and a violation of cultural heritage.
